name: weekday
expr: w1 = weekday(d1); w2 = weekday(d2); w3 = weekday(d3); w4 = weekday(d4); wv = weekday(v);
comment: MATLAB weekday: day-of-week index 1=Sun..7=Sat (US calendar). Covers single-date, vector input, historical dates spanning 60+ years (1970, 2000, 2026), and one full week roundtrip 7,1,2,3,4,5,6. Optional name string output ('short'/'long') tested in gtest only -- parity harness fingerprints numeric only. Algorithm: ((floor(d) - 2) mod 7) + 1 with positive-modulo (serial 1 = Saturday in MATLAB's calendar).
